definitions.gloss: algae; seaweed and related organisms as a biological group
definitions.explanation: A broad category of photosynthetic organisms that live in water, ranging from microscopic single-celled organisms to large seaweeds. A scientific classification term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{藻類|そうるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Algae are proliferating in the pond.

examples.japanese: {藻類|そうるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{光合成|こうごうせい}→光合成：08403_kougousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Algae are organisms that perform photosynthesis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、バイオ⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{藻類|そうるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, algae have been attracting attention as a raw material for biofuel.

notes:
A scientific term combining {藻|そう} (seaweed; algae) and ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (class; kind). Used in biology, environmental science, and increasingly in discussions of biofuel and sustainable technology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藻類|そうるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧: algae proliferation
- {藻類|そうるい}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: algae research
- {藻類|そうるい}バイオ⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧: algae biofuel
- ⟦{微細|びさい}→微細：12690_bisai⟧{藻類|そうるい}: microalgae
- {緑|みどり}{藻類|そうるい}: green algae

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海藻|かいそう}→海藻：06750_kaisou⟧: seaweed — specifically marine algae; the everyday word for edible seaweed
- ⟦{藻|も}→藻：14821_mo⟧: water plant; pond weed — the native Japanese word, often refers to freshwater aquatic plants
- ⟦{水草|みずくさ}→水草：28853_mizukusa⟧: aquatic plant; water plant — broader term including non-algae aquatic plants
